column1: # readable_scopes.tsv: the published -only scope of scoped companion specs (readable_check.py runs them with it).
# Format: spec<TAB>ADDR[,ADDR...]   # where the scope comes from (the gate that verified/merged the unit).
# A companion that only steers some functions passes those under -only; outside its scope its fixture is not a
# valid input domain (e.g. HUD text_vtable: 026E6F48/026E7CD0 differ on stack data unscoped, in the merged
# reference too). Specs whose header says "run with -only ADDR" are scoped by that comment and need no line.
